## Configuration

Configuration is loaded from `-config`, then `CONFIG_PATH`, then `configs/config.yaml`.

Environment variables override file values:

```sh
CONFIG_PATH=configs/config.yaml APP_ENV=development SERVER_PORT=8080 LOGGING_FORMAT=text DATABASE_MONGODB_HOST=localhost:27017 DATABASE_MONGODB_DATABASE=app make run
```



MongoDB is initialized as a database client during startup and checked by readiness when enabled. No SQL framework or migration settings are generated.
